title.narrative: Réseau d'Afrique Centrale pour la Santé Reproductive des Femmes : Gabon, Cameroun, Guinée équatoria

description.narrative: GCG's vision is to improve women's reproductive health services by facilitating inter-regional exchanges and combining research projects, training and educational programs on pregnancy prevention, pregnancy support and pregnancy termination. GCG implements feasible strategies to strengthen the skills of local health practitioners and ensure access to quality medical care for women, particularly rural women, adolescent girls and migrants. The Equality Fund grant will be used to finance operational expenses including part of the operating costs. This grant also supports: -Radio animation in rural areas -Giving voice to populations on "taboo" issues around sexuality, abortion. -Information, training on misoprostol-Getting health workers in both urban and rural areas to be able to use misoprostol correctly -Engaging in new regions-Being able to go to new villages and get women to discuss their concerns about sexuality, pregnancy and pregnancy-related complications.
